The August 12 meeting established that Deal Review centers on vendor contracts, requiring you to align directly with CIO partners to insert tech decisions into procurement packets early. You need to investigate the unusually high cost of Category 3 items—averaging over $1M per item—while shifting architecture due diligence left to the first 15 business days of the triage phase.
